findings.requirement: Exactly two decision actions: primary 'Отправить интерес' and ghost 'Сейчас не подходит'; no dating terms (Лайк/Свайп/Суперлайк).
findings.actual: Two buttons: primary 'Отправить интерес' (opens InterestModal), ghost 'Сейчас не подходит' (POST /api/feed/skip). No like/swipe/superlike terminology in component or copy.

findings.requirement: Only published, verified, active profiles participate; unpublished/under-review/rejected profiles not shown.
findings.actual: Effective (latest) get_recommendations RPC filters candidate c.lifecycle_state='active', c.verification_status='approved', cp.status='published', and EXISTS an approved profile photo. Confirmed 20260630000000 is the last redefinition of the function.

findings.requirement: Hard filters enforce mutual gender preference and mutual age range.
findings.actual: cp.gender = v.looking_for_gender AND v.gender = cp.looking_for_gender (mutual gender); candidate age BETWEEN v.partner_age_min/max AND viewer age BETWEEN cp.partner_age_min/max (mutual age).

findings.requirement: Recommendations exclude self, blocked pairs (either direction), previously skipped (match_views), and active/recently-declined match_requests.
findings.actual: c.id <> p_viewer (self); NOT EXISTS blocks either direction; NOT EXISTS match_views (skip); NOT EXISTS accepted or live-pending match_request either direction, plus viewer->candidate declined. (RPC excludes only viewer->candidate declined, not the reverse — spec is directionally ambiguous and the harassment-relevant re-send block is handled correctly in process_interest; not a defect.)

findings.requirement: RPC enforces viewer-side gating (defense-in-depth): non-active/non-approved viewer receives empty result even if page guard bypassed.
findings.actual: Effective RPC's viewer CTE 'v' requires u.lifecycle_state='active' AND u.verification_status='approved'; a shadow/paused/rejected viewer yields an empty CTE, so the CROSS JOIN v produces zero rows. Viewer gate carried forward from 20260626000000 into the latest 20260630000000 definition.

findings.requirement: Skip persists a permanent exclusion in match_views so candidate not re-shown (anti-roulette on refresh).
findings.actual: Skip route upserts match_views {viewer_id, target_id} (onConflict viewer_id,target_id) — permanent row, no TTL. RPC excludes any candidate with a match_views row for the viewer. Skip additionally consumes the 30/day views quota.

findings.requirement: Chat MUST NOT open until mutual interest; communication only after both parties express interest.
findings.actual: Chat (ensureChat/insert into chats) is created only in process_interest step 4 when a reciprocal live-pending interest exists (result 'mutual'); a first-time interest returns 'sent' with no chat. Route redirects to /chats only on mutual.

findings.requirement: Sending interest pre-checks receiver active, neither blocked, sender daily quota; typed errors unavailable/blocked/daily_limit/already_sent/declined.
findings.actual: Route checks target exists & lifecycle_state==='active' (else 'unavailable' 404), areBlocked (else 'blocked' 403); process_interest handles blocked/daily_limit/already_sent/declined_block atomically; switch maps to typed errors unavailable/blocked/daily_limit/already_sent/declined.

findings.requirement: Optional accompanying message capped at 300 characters.
findings.actual: Textarea onChange slices to 300 chars (UI), counter shows N/300; server passes message?.slice(0,300) to RPC. Message optional (message.trim() || undefined).

findings.requirement: Interest message rejected if it contains contact info (phone/messenger/link).
findings.actual: Route: if (message && containsContact(message)) return error 'contact_blocked' 400 before RPC. containsContact tests PHONE/HANDLE/LINK/MESSENGER regexes on NFKC-normalized text.

findings.requirement: Pending interest auto-closes 72h after send (auto_decline_at = sent_at + 72h); sender confirmation copy states the 72-hour window.
findings.actual: AUTO_DECLINE_HOURS=72 passed as p_hours; RPC inserts auto_decline_at = now() + make_interval(hours=>p_hours). InterestModal sent-state copy (sentDescription, ru & uz) states 'через 72 часа заявка автоматически закроется'.

findings.requirement: On mutual interest, system atomically accepts, creates/returns chat, routes both users into it.
findings.actual: process_interest step 4 (under advisory xact lock + SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on reverse pending) sets reverse request accepted, inserts/returns chat idempotently, returns 'mutual' + chat_id; route redirects sender to /chats/{chat_id} and notifies receiver (mutual_match). Receiver's own accept path in decision/route.ts is a separate atomic conditional UPDATE + ensureChat.

findings.requirement: Receiver can accept/decline without reason; accept opens chat + notifies sender; decline sends no aggressive rejection notification (soft closed in history).
findings.actual: decline: conditional UPDATE status='declined', returns ok, comment 'отправителя НЕ уведомляем (бережём)' — no enqueueAndDeliver. accept: conditional UPDATE status='accepted', ensureChat, enqueueAndDeliver(sender,'interest_accepted'). Neither requires a reason field.

findings.requirement: Sender can withdraw own still-pending interest; afterwards not shown to receiver.
findings.actual: withdraw action: sender-only guard (r.sender_id===user.id else 403), conditional UPDATE status='withdrawn' WHERE status='pending'. Incoming list query filters status='pending' AND auto_decline_at>now, so withdrawn no longer appears to receiver.

findings.requirement: After receiver declines, sender blocked from re-sending to that receiver for 30 days.
findings.actual: Effective (latest) process_interest step 5: EXISTS declined request sender->receiver with created_at > now() - interval '30 days' → returns 'declined_block'. Confirmed 20260602170000 supersedes the unbounded declined check in 20260602160000.

findings.requirement: State transitions atomic and guarded by status='pending' (no double-accept/stale writes); expired requests not acceptable.
findings.actual: Each of withdraw/decline/accept is a conditional UPDATE ... WHERE id=? AND status='pending' RETURNING id; empty result → 'not_pending' 409; DB error → 'failed' 500. Expired guard L56-59: if auto_decline_at < now, transition to 'expired' and return 'expired' 409 before accept/decline.

findings.requirement: Expired pending interest presented to sender as 'expired'/closed at read time (lazy expiry), not 'awaiting reply' forever.
findings.actual: effectiveStatus(r) returns 'expired' when status==='pending' && auto_decline_at <= now, even though DB row is still pending. Outgoing list uses effectiveStatus for the status label and only shows RequestActions when effectiveStatus==='pending'.

findings.requirement: Daily interest limit 5/day and skip(views) limit 30/day, atomic at Asia/Tashkent day boundary; soft 'come back tomorrow' on exceed.
findings.actual: DAILY_LIMITS={interests:5, views:30}. bump_quota (effective def) computes day via (now() at time zone 'Asia/Tashkent')::date and does atomic conditional UPDATE WHERE count<limit RETURNING. Skip 429 → soft copy 'На сегодня достаточно… загляните завтра'. Interest daily_limit → soft errorCopy in InterestModal.

findings.requirement: Scoring inputs: city match, shared life values (capped), Big Five vector proximity, age proximity, sorted desc; no worldview/family-role/culture weighting in MVP.
findings.actual: scoreCandidate adds +30 city match, +10*min(shared,3) values (capped at 3), +round((100-avgVectorDiff)*0.4), +max(0,20-|ageDiff|). recommend.ts sorts scored desc by score. No religion/family-role/culture terms in scorer.

findings.requirement: Story reasons/cautions/advice derived from shared values, same-religion equality (excl na/none, ignoring practice), children-plan compat/conflict, vector proximity, city; religion difference alone not a caution.
findings.actual: reasonsFor: shared values, religion equality excluding 'na'/'none' (no practice level), both-pro/both-no children, vector diff<18, same city. cautionsFor: children conflict, geo mismatch, age out of mutual range — religion difference deliberately excluded (L148-150). adviceFor keyed off shared[0] via ADVICE_BY_VALUE (all 14 LIFE_VALUES_V3 keys covered).

findings.requirement: No sufficiently-matching candidate → calm empty state ('Алгоритм ищет… загляните через сутки'), encourage profile/quiz completion, not error/empty feed.
findings.actual: When getMatchOfTheDay returns null, page renders 'Алгоритм ищет подходящего человека' + 'Загляните через сутки' + prompt to complete anketa/psycho-portrait. Calm empty state, no error.

findings.requirement: Interest/received-interest surface permission-gated: only verified may view feed, send interest, view/act on received; shadow rejected 403.
findings.actual: interest→requirePermissionForRequest('send_interest'), feed/skip→'view_feed', decision→'view_received_interests'. permissions.ts grants these only to 'verified' role; shadow role lists none of them (comment 'НЕ send_interest…'). with-permission returns 403 permission_denied when role lacks the permission.

findings.requirement: Safety actions (report/block) MUST be available to all users regardless of subscription_plan; safety MUST NOT be gated behind Premium.
findings.actual: report_user/block_user are granted by DERIVED ROLE (verified + paused), never by plan. There is no subscription_plan concept anywhere in the codebase (grep for subscription_plan/tariff gating returns nothing); DAILY_LIMITS is a single flat constant. Safety therefore cannot be gated behind Premium — the gating dimension does not exist.

findings.requirement: A blocked user MUST lose product access; only support/appeal remains; retains delete_account+export_account GDPR floor; API returns 403 'blocked'.
findings.actual: ROLE_PERMISSIONS.blocked = only delete_account + export_account. requirePermissionForRequest returns 403 error:'blocked' for any permission outside that set. Bans set lifecycle_state='blocked' (admin_ban_confirm migration), which deriveRole maps to 'blocked'. Matches spec exactly.

findings.requirement: Shadow/unverified active user MUST NOT participate in Matching (no feed, no interests, no chat) but can view/edit own анкета + manage account.
findings.actual: ROLE_PERMISSIONS.shadow lacks view_feed/be_visible_in_feed/send_interest/receive_interest/open_chat; retains view_own_profile/edit_own_profile/account mgmt. deriveRole maps active+non-approved verification to 'shadow'. Satisfies spec (this is the ledger Shadow-Active model).

findings.requirement: Reporting MUST create a moderation complaint at any moment; reason codes MUST include fake, offensive, contacts/pressure-for-phone, spam, inappropriate, other.
findings.actual: REASONS = [fake, offensive, contacts, spam, inappropriate, other] — all six required categories present. POST inserts into reports table with status default 'new' (moderation queue). Available on any profile via ProfileSafetyActions.

findings.requirement: complaint_status MUST support full lifecycle: new/submitted, received, in_progress, requires_clarification, not_confirmed, resolved variants, action_taken, escalated, closed.
findings.actual: complaint_status enum = new, in_progress, confirmed, not_confirmed, action_taken, closed, requires_clarification, escalated. Matches ledger status_map §1.9 (requires_clarification/escalated marked Stage 2 in ledger but present in enum). Adequate coverage of the required lifecycle.

findings.requirement: Reporter MUST stay anonymous; after reporting user MUST see: 'Спасибо. Мы получили вашу жалобу и проверим ситуацию. Ваша личность не будет раскрыта другому пользователю.'
findings.actual: Anonymity is structurally guaranteed (reporter_id never exposed to violator; no reporter-facing field surfaced). But the confirmation copy is 'Спасибо, жалоба отправлена' / 'Жалоба отправлена' — it DROPS the explicit anonymity-guarantee sentence the spec requires. Substance gap (user is not reassured their identity stays hidden), not just a paraphrase.
findings.verify_evidence: messages/ru.json:474 report_done="Спасибо, жалоба отправлена." and ru.json:775 reportSentLabel="Жалоба отправлена" — these are the only post-report confirmation strings, shown via ProfileSafetyActions.tsx:51 (reportSentLabel on the button after onSent). A repo-wide grep for личность/раскрыт/анонимн found NO string containing the required sentence 'Ваша личность не будет раскрыта другому пользователю' in any user-facing confirmation. Anonymity IS structurally guaranteed (api/report/route.ts stores reporter_id server-side, never returns it to the violator), but the explicit reassurance copy is dropped. Strong discriminator: the block flow DOES carry an analogous reassurance — ProfileSafetyActions.tsx:330 BlockConfirm says '{firstName} не узнает об этом' — so the reassurance was specifically omitted from the report path, not absent by design. No ledger OD defers this copy.
findings.verify_note: Substance gap, not paraphrase: user is never told their identity stays hidden after reporting.

findings.requirement: Blocking MUST be mutual/silent: blocked user can no longer message, send interests, or see blocker in recommendations; enforced both directions.
findings.actual: areBlocked() checks both directions (blocker_id/blocked_id ∈ {a,b}). blockUser tears down pending requests both ways. Interest route + process_interest RPC + message POST all refuse on block. No notification is sent to the blocked party (silent). Block confirm copy also states 'не узнает об этом'. Satisfies spec.

findings.requirement: When a block exists either direction, existing chats and unread counters MUST be hidden from chat list, and message sending MUST be refused.
findings.actual: get_chat_list and get_unread_total both exclude chats where a block exists in either direction (NOT EXISTS on blocks). Message POST returns 403 'blocked' via areBlocked. Matches built-spec.

findings.requirement: Safety Center MUST expose 'Жалобы и блокировки' as the FIRST/most-accessible item, offering: report profile, report message/chat, block user, VIEW BLOCKED USERS, and view account restrictions.
findings.actual: No consolidated Safety Center screen exists. V2 settings page has only self-summary + pause/resume/delete + version; no 'Жалобы и блокировки' entry. Report/Block exist ONLY on the profile page (ProfileSafetyActions). There is NO blocked-users list (block route has no GET; no route reads blocks for the owner) and NO account-restrictions view. Report-message-from-chat exists (chat has report button) but is not surfaced through a center. No ledger OD defers this.
findings.verify_evidence: src/app/[locale]/v2/settings/page.tsx:50-101 renders ONLY a self-summary (name/age/city/status roleLabel) + V2SettingsActions + versionInfo. V2SettingsActions (src/components/v2/SettingsActions.tsx) contains only pause/resume + delete-account — no safety entry. No consolidated 'Жалобы и блокировки' screen exists: grep found that string only in src/content/legal.ts:380 (a legal-doc heading, not UI). Report/Block live solely on the profile page (ProfileSafetyActions). No blocked-users list: src/app/api/block/route.ts has only POST (block/unblock), no GET; blocks table is read only inside areBlocked() (safety/blocks.ts) as a boolean guard and written via upsert/delete — never listed for the owner. No account-restrictions view anywhere. No ledger OD/known_deviation defers a Safety Center — the ledger enumerates Stage-2 deferrals exhaustively (OD-13/14/15/16, per-block visibility) and none cover this.
findings.verify_note: Report-from-chat exists (chat has a report button) but is not surfaced through any center; blocked-list and restrictions view are entirely absent.

findings.requirement: Profile display_name and bio MUST reject contact info (phone/Telegram/handles/links); a profile with contacts MUST NOT be published.
findings.actual: containsContact (PHONE_RE, HANDLE_RE, LINK_RE, MESSENGER_RE with homoglyph/NFKC handling) is applied via Zod .refine on display_name ('name_has_contacts') and bio/self ('bio_has_contacts'); validation failure blocks the write, so a contact-bearing profile cannot be saved/published. Satisfies spec.

findings.requirement: System MUST block passing contact info in chat messages and interest cover messages; attempts to send contacts MUST be logged.
findings.citation: chat5_safety.md §8.3 lines 751-769; §28 Логирование 'попытки отправить контакты' line 2022
findings.actual: Blocking half is satisfied: containsContact rejects contacts in interest cover message and in chat messages (400 contact_blocked). LOGGING half is NOT implemented — neither route writes any record of the blocked attempt; logging infra (adminAudit / user_state_transitions / admin_login_attempts) has no contact-attempt sink. The §28 'попытки отправить контакты' logging requirement is unmet, with no ledger justification.
findings.verify_evidence: Blocking half satisfied: src/app/api/interest/route.ts:32-33 rejects containsContact(message) with 400 contact_blocked; src/app/api/chats/[id]/messages/route.ts:51-52 rejects containsContact(text) with 400 contact_blocked. containsContact (src/lib/profile/schemas.ts:84) genuinely detects phones/handles/links/messengers. LOGGING half unmet: both routes simply return the 400 with NO insert to any log/audit table on the blocked branch. Grep for contact_attempt / попытк.*контакт / blocked_attempt found no sink; the audit infra (adminAudit→admin_audit_log in lib/admin/guard.ts:50, user_state_transitions in lib/state-machine/transitions.ts, admin_login_attempts in lib/admin/throttle.ts) has no contact-attempt path. §28 'попытки отправить контакты' logging requirement is unmet with no ledger justification.
findings.verify_note: Block-but-don't-log confirmed on both the interest cover message and chat message paths.

findings.requirement: Before first chat message, user MUST see a safety warning discouraging sharing phone, address, documents, or workplace until sufficient trust (specific copy).
findings.actual: Mechanism IS present: when the chat is empty (before first message) ChatRoom renders safety_tip_extended. But the copy ('Не делитесь номерами и ссылками в чате — это правило сохраняется до встречи...') drops the spec-required mention of address, documents, and workplace and the 'Baxtlilar не требует раскрывать личные контакты' line. Warning shown; wording is a reduced paraphrase.
findings.verify_evidence: src/components/v2/ChatRoom.tsx:298-314 renders t('safety_tip_extended') when empty (chat has no messages = before first message). That string (messages/ru.json:507) is 'Не делитесь номерами и ссылками в чате — это правило сохраняется до встречи. И, если что-то пошло не так — кнопка «пожаловаться» сверху.' — it omits the spec-required mention of address, documents, and workplace, and the 'Baxtlilar не требует раскрывать личные контакты' line. The fuller string safety_tip (ru.json:498, which does mention 'адрес') is DEAD CODE: grep confirms safety_tip is referenced only in a comment (ChatRoom.tsx:52) and never rendered; only safety_tip_extended is used (ChatRoom.tsx:312). Warning is shown at the right moment but the wording is a reduced paraphrase. No ledger deferral.
findings.verify_note: Mechanism present, copy incomplete. Note: spec file chat5_safety.md is not in the repo, so the exact required copy is taken from the finding's requirement text, not re-read from the spec.

findings.requirement: Restrictions MUST follow an escalation ladder (first→repeat→serious) with graduated sanctions warning→chat limit→temp/perm ban; threats MUST trigger immediate ban.
findings.actual: No automated escalation ladder is built. sanction_level enum exists but is NEVER read anywhere in code; graduated sanctions (interest_limited/chat_limited/hidden_from_recommendations) are Stage 2 per ledger status_map §1.10. Moderators apply verdicts manually via decision route (status→action_taken etc.); bans go through lifecycle_state='blocked'. MVP handles ban-or-not manually per OD-10 (1-2 mods, 24h SLA); the ladder is deferred.
findings.od_ref: status_map §1.10 (Stage 2); OD-10

findings.requirement: A restricted user MUST have partial access with interest/chat/Matching restrictions for a duration, reversible via appeal or expiry (restriction_status).
findings.actual: Restriction sub-statuses (interest_limited, chat_limited, hidden_from_recommendations, re_verification) are Stage 2 per ledger status_map §1.10 and are not enforced; sanction_level column is never read. Only the terminal none/temp_block(→blocked)/perm_block MVP path exists, handled via lifecycle_state. Partial-access 'restricted user' role is deferred.
findings.od_ref: status_map §1.10 (interest_limited/chat_limited/hidden_from_recommendations = Stage 2)

findings.requirement: Re-registration after block / block-circumvention with a new account MUST result in blocking the new account; phone_blacklist tombstone with linked_user_id survives to catch re-registration.
findings.actual: phone_blacklist has linked_user_id (ON DELETE SET NULL) written on blocking-reject; document_sha_blacklist tombstones passport/selfie. Re-registration with the same phone is refused during onboarding ('этот номер недавно использовался...'). Tombstone survives soft-delete. Satisfies built-spec.

findings.requirement: Moderation verdicts MUST be performed by moderation authority only and recorded in admin audit log; decision route restricts to superadmin and writes adminAudit action report_<status>.
findings.actual: Route calls requireAdminApi then hard-rejects non-superadmin (403 forbidden) — closes the moderator-curl regression. On successful reports.update it writes adminAudit({action:`report_${status}`, entity:'report', ...}) only after confirmed update. Matches built-spec.

findings.requirement: System MUST log safety-relevant actions: profile changes, privacy changes, complaints, moderator decisions, blocks, gift/trusted-person/contact-sending attempts, re-verifications.
findings.actual: Partial. Moderator decisions (adminAudit) and state transitions (user_state_transitions) are logged. But complaints (reports.insert), user blocks (blocks.upsert in /api/block, /api/report), and contact-sending attempts are NOT written to any audit log. The contact-attempt logging clause overlaps SAF-015 and is unmet; block/complaint audit trails also absent. Partial-coverage gap, no ledger justification.
findings.verify_evidence: Partial coverage confirmed. Logged: moderator decisions via adminAudit()→admin_audit_log (src/lib/admin/guard.ts:40-60) and status changes via transition()→user_state_transitions (src/lib/state-machine/transitions.ts:44), which also covers re-verifications. NOT logged: complaints — src/app/api/report/route.ts inserts only into 'reports', no audit entry; blocks — blockUser() (src/lib/safety/blocks.ts) writes only to 'blocks' + 'match_requests', and api/block/route.ts + api/report/route.ts add no audit record; contact-sending attempts — unlogged (see SAF-015). No ledger OD/known_deviation defers safety-action audit logging; the ledger's Stage-2 list does not include it. Genuine partial-coverage gap.
findings.verify_note: Verdict rests on blocks/complaints/contact-attempts being unlogged, which is directly verified. I did not separately verify profile-change / privacy-change logging, but the confirmed gaps already establish the requirement is unmet.

findings.requirement: Daily anti-spam limits MUST be enforced per plan: interests/day Free 1/Plus 3/Pro 5; pending Free 1-2/Plus 3/Pro 5; active connections Free 0/Plus 1/Pro 2; recs/day Free 5-10/Plus 20/Pro 40.
findings.actual: Limits are FLAT, not per-plan: DAILY_LIMITS = { interests: 5, views: 30 }, enforced atomically in process_interest via bump_quota → 429 daily_limit. No plan tiering, no active-connections limit. This matches founder resolution OD-6 (5 interests + 30 views/day, then tune) and the tariff amendment (VIP does not buy access to people), which supersede the raw-chat per-plan table.
findings.od_ref: OD-6; tariff founder_amendment (OD-13/RU-2)

findings.requirement: A pending interest MUST auto-close after 72h of no response with user-facing text about the 72h auto-close.
findings.actual: AUTO_DECLINE_HOURS=72 passed as p_hours; process_interest sets auto_decline_at = now()+72h and expires stale pending rows. User-facing copy present ('через 72 часа заявка автоматически закроется...'). Matches OD-7. Copy is a paraphrase of §19.7 but conveys the substance.

findings.requirement: Interests/messaging/visibility MUST be refused when target not active; outbound interest MUST NOT be delivered to a deleted/inactive target.
findings.actual: Interest route loads target and returns 404 'unavailable' unless lifecycle_state==='active'. Profile page also gates on areBlocked. Outbox worker skips deleted accounts. Satisfies built-spec.

findings.requirement: Changing identity-verified fields (name/gender/birth date/photos/marital status/residence country) or multiple fakeness complaints MUST trigger re-verification; verification MUST NOT be final if such changes occur.
findings.actual: No automatic re-verification trigger on identity-field edits or complaint accumulation. verification_status 'revoked' exists as an enum value but is Stage 2 per ledger status_map §1.4 ('revoked(M) = Stage 2'). Anketa edit-flow is a TODO (Sprint 16, settings page comment); no code re-opens verification on name/photo change. Deferred, not a wired bug.
findings.od_ref: status_map §1.4 (revoked = Stage 2)

findings.requirement: Age-gate 18+: profiles from minors MUST be rejected (birth_date refine ageFromDate>=18 → 'must_be_18').
findings.actual: basicSchema.birth_date has .refine(ageFromDate(s) >= 18, 'must_be_18') plus upper bound <=100. ageFromDate computes full years to today. Under-18 profiles fail validation and cannot be saved. Matches OD-5 hard 18+ gate.

findings.requirement: A report MUST also sever contact (equivalent to block): cut pending requests + mute chat; invariant E1 — /api/report calls blockUser.
findings.actual: /api/report calls blockUser(user.id, target_user_id) BEFORE dedup, so every report (including repeats) guarantees the block: upserts blocks row, declines incoming pending, withdraws outgoing pending; areBlocked then mutes the chat. Fails the request if the cut fails (safety-critical). Satisfies invariant E1.

findings.requirement: Manual review screen: moderator reviews one pending user at a time; can approve identity, request correction (needs-changes), or reject.
findings.actual: 3-step studio (docs → passport data entry → face match → decision) reviews one case at a time. DecisionPanel offers Approve, Needs-changes (переснять), Reject-technical, and Blocking-reject. Satisfies the screen requirement.

findings.requirement: Claim-based workflow: case starts new/unassigned, admin claims (becomes assignee), only assigning admin may continue; case claimed by another is not editable.
findings.actual: admin_claim_verification atomically sets assignee and returns case_already_claimed for a different admin. All mutating RPCs (save_draft/approve/reject/blocking) reject with not_claimed_by_you unless assignee_id == p_admin_id. CaseStudio shows 'Кейс уже обрабатывается другим админом' and blocks editing.

findings.requirement: 'Данные из документа' block captures document number (series+number), birth date, issue date, expiry date, gender, citizenship.
findings.actual: Form captures passport_series, passport_number, PINFL, issued_by, issued_at, expires_at, birth_date, gender, citizenship (plus birth_place and full address). All required document fields present.

findings.requirement: Record full name (last/first/middle) so document data can be compared against profile fields.
findings.actual: last_name/first_name/middle_name captured and persisted to user_identity. DecisionPanel summary shows entered ФИО; CaseHeader shows profile display_name for comparison. Note: there is no side-by-side auto-diff widget, but the fields required for comparison are captured.

findings.requirement: Approving gated by a pre-approval checklist (document readable, expiry valid, data matches, photo matches, no risk factors, comment added); 'Подтвердить личность' active only after checklist completed.
findings.actual: Reaching the decision step is gated: step 2 blocks on invalid/missing data, and step 3 requires a 3-item manual checklist (face matches, liveness, age plausible) before the Approve button is reachable, plus an approve confirmation dialog. However there is no mandatory free-text comment before approve, and 'document readable' / 'expiry valid' are not explicit checklist items (expiry is only a soft warn, not gated). Substance of the gate is met; two checklist specifics are missing.

findings.requirement: Face comparison relies on a human moderator confirming selfie matches passport photo; automated similarity score is only a hint, soft phrasing not 'точно фейк'.
findings.actual: FaceMatchStep shows selfie and passport photo side by side and requires the moderator to manually check 'Лицо на селфи совпадает с фото в паспорте', liveness, and age. No automated similarity score is shown or used at all — decision is fully human. Satisfies (and exceeds) the human-in-the-loop requirement.

findings.requirement: 'Подтвердить личность' action requires an explicit confirmation step before applied.
findings.actual: Approve opens a confirmation Dialog ('Подтвердите создание клиента') with Отмена/Подтвердить before the decision RPC is called. Confirmed.

findings.requirement: Reject-verification and request-correction require a reason before submit; reject additionally requires confirmation.
findings.actual: needs_changes/reject_technical use a confirmation Dialog with a ReasonPicker; submit disabled unless reason_text length >= 3. Blocking-reject requires category + reason (>=3) behind a danger confirm dialog. Route and RPC both re-check reason server-side. Confirmed.

findings.requirement: Rejection reasons selected from a predefined list (not free text alone); correction reasons from a defined list.
findings.actual: Correction/technical rejects use admin_reason_templates (6 predefined verification reasons, RU/UZ) via a dropdown ReasonPicker (editable text). Blocking-reject uses a hardcoded predefined category list (fake/minor/catfish → подделка/несовершеннолетний/чужой документ). Reasons are predefined-list-driven; the template set is somewhat correction-skewed but the blocking categories cover the hard rejection grounds. Substantially satisfied.

findings.requirement: Rejecting an underage user must be a blocking rejection category, distinct from technical needs-changes.
findings.actual: 'minor' is a distinct blocking-reject category (permanent block + 10y phone tombstone), separate from needs_changes/reject_technical. Passport validation hard-blocks age<18 with message 'требуется blocking-reject (категория minor)'. Confirmed.

findings.requirement: Expired document (expiry in past) must be surfaced; expiry validity is a checked field and 'документ просрочен' is a rejection ground.
findings.actual: Expiry-in-past is surfaced to the moderator as a field-level warning ('Паспорт просрочен'), and the DB trigger enforces expires_at > issued_at. However it is only a soft warn (does not block approve) and there is no dedicated 'документ просрочен' reason-template as a rejection ground; the moderator must free-type it. Surfaced but not a first-class rejection ground.

findings.requirement: On approval status → verified; on correction/reject status → needs_changes/rejected; user notified of negative decision.
findings.actual: approve sets users.verification_status='approved' and enqueues verification_approved push; reject sets needs_changes/rejected and enqueues verification_needs_changes/verification_rejected; blocking-reject blocks user and enqueues verification_rejected. Status transitions and user notification all present.

findings.requirement: Identity docs/selfies for identity-check only; must NOT be shown to other users or reused as profile photos; must NOT be visible to ordinary moderators without an Identity Manager (document-access) role.
findings.actual: Reuse-as-public-photo concern is a false alarm: approved selfie is stored to users.avatar_path but is rendered ONLY on admin surfaces (grep for avatar_path/avatar_url in src/app/[locale] and non-admin components returns nothing); other users see photos exclusively from profile_photos (matching main_photo_path and post-mutual reveal). Role-gating concern is only partly met: there are only two roles (superadmin/moderator) — no dedicated 'Identity Manager' document-access role. Any moderator who claims an in-queue case gets signed passport+selfie URLs via loadCase. The finer-grained document-access role is not built (moderators are scoped to in-queue cases via F-120, which is the ledger-recognized substitute).
findings.od_ref: known_deviations: admin redesign Sprint 1 (superadmin/moderator + F-120 in-queue scope; Identity Manager role not in MVP scope)

findings.requirement: Viewing a document requires permission + reason + audit; downloading requires separate download_identity_documents permission + reason + audit, limited to super_admin/identity_manager.
findings.actual: loadCase mints 300s signed passport and selfie URLs whenever a case page is opened, with NO reason prompt and NO audit event of any kind for the document view, and no separate download permission/reason/audit. The admin_scope_violations log only records out-of-queue attempts, not in-scope document views. No deferral for this control found in docs/ledger. Required view/download audit is missing.

findings.requirement: Case events / verification history must be immutable (append-only): cannot be edited or deleted through the admin UI.
findings.actual: case_events has a DB trigger prevent_case_events_mutation that raises on any UPDATE or DELETE — append-only enforced at the database, not just the UI. (Separately, no case-history view is rendered in the UI, but that is a non-required surfacing gap, not an immutability violation.)

findings.requirement: Moderator queue shows admin's own claimed cases and unassigned/new cases with counts; a claimed case appears in the assignee's queue only.
findings.actual: loadMyQueue filters assignee_id==admin AND state!=closed; loadUnassignedQueue filters assignee_id IS NULL AND state='new'. Page shows both sections with counts ('N в работе · M без владельца'). A claimed case appears only in the assignee's 'mine' queue. Confirmed.

findings.requirement: A verification case stalled past its SLA must be surfaced as overdue (просрочка SLA visible on the status timeline) so a supervisor can act.
findings.actual: No 'просрочка SLA' indicator on any case status timeline in the UI (CaseHeader/queue have no SLA pill; case_events timeline is not rendered). The only SLA mechanism is a backend cron reclaim (admin_sla_reclaim_stale_cases, 168h/7d abandonment → re-queue to 'new'), which is abandonment recovery, not the 24h moderation SLA (OD-10) visualization. The plan doc explicitly defers 'SLA pills' to Sprint 3.
findings.od_ref: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-27-admin-redesign-sprint-1-foundation.md:3878 (SLA pills deferred to Sprint 3); OD-10 (SLA up to 24h)

findings.requirement: Clients directory: single registry of all users, searchable by ID, name, phone, Telegram, with filters for status, verification state, plan, gender, country.
findings.actual: Directory searchable by ФИО/ПИНФЛ/паспорт/telephone/@username/ (admin_search_clients pg_trgm RPC) with status and gender pill filters. However verification-state, plan/tariff, and country filters are NOT present (only lifecycle status + gender). Search coverage is broad; filter set is partial vs spec.

findings.requirement: In the clients table full phone and Telegram must NOT be shown; phone search / full contact data restricted to contact-access roles (masked otherwise).
findings.actual: Clients directory table returns phone_number_masked (maskPhone: first4 *** last4) and the whole /admin/clients directory is gated to superadmin only (moderators redirected to their queue). Phone is masked in the row shape. Full contact data is thus restricted. Satisfied.

findings.requirement: Once verified, approved identity full name and document/PINFL data must be available for lookup on the client record (search by PINFL/passport/name).
findings.actual: user_identity (active row) is joined into search results (full_name, pinfl, passport) and the client card IdentityTab renders the verified ФИО/ПИНФЛ/passport/address. admin_search_clients matches PINFL/passport/name. Identity data is bound to the user and looked up. Confirmed.

findings.requirement: Photo-moderation screen lets moderator review profile photos and approve / send for correction / reject per photo_moderation_status set.
findings.actual: Photo queue (New / Overdue>24h tabs) with per-photo approve/reject and a drawer for detailed review. Decision route updates profile_photos.status to approved/rejected. Note: the action set is binary approve/reject (no distinct needs_changes/needs_replacement state exposed), but per-photo review + approve/reject is present.

findings.requirement: Rejecting/sending a photo for correction requires a reason from a defined reason set; rejecting all photos requires confirmation + reason.

findings.requirement: lifecycle_state transitions MUST be restricted to the given matrix; deleted is terminal (no outgoing).

The TS guard in transition() validates ONLY onboarding_step against ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS (types.ts). transition_user RPC blindly coalesces lifecycle_state from the patch with no from->to matrix check, and no DB trigger/CHECK constrains lifecycle edges. findings.verify_evidence: transition_user RPC coalesces lifecycle_state directly from the patch with NO from->to matrix: supabase/migrations/20260619500001_admin_oversight_fixes.sql:203 `lifecycle_state = coalesce((p_patch->>'lifecycle_state')::lifecycle_state, lifecycle_state)`; identical blind coalesce in 20260601140000_hardening.sql:31. The only guard is lines 196-200 rejecting targets IN ('blocked','pending_ban'). The TS guard (transitions.ts:59-66) validates ONLY onboarding_step against ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS, never lifecycle_state. grep for lifecycle CHECK/trigger returns nothing (only a comment at fixes:110). CANONICAL STATUS MAP (Chat 13 Part 1, v2.0, spec-canonical — Shadow Active NOT folded in; it lives in known_deviations).

RULE 1: any status change only via transition(userId, patch, reason, triggeredBy) writing user_state_transitions; direct UPDATE forbidden. RULE 2: approved ≠ published (moderator approves, user publishes).

lifecycle_state (§1.2, global; C=system unless noted): onboarding (created) → active (after quiz) → paused (P, self, MVP-P2) → blocked (M, ban) → deleted (P, soft-delete, terminal). Transitions: onboarding→{active,blocked,deleted}; active→{paused,blocked,deleted}; paused→{active,blocked,deleted}; blocked→{active(unban),deleted}; deleted=terminal. All MVP.

onboarding_step ORDER (§1.3, MVP). BOT part: bot_started → language (UZ/RU) → consent_basic_pd → consent_cross_border → tg_contact_requested → tg_contact_received (hard-check contact.user_id==from.id) → bot_completed. BOUNDARY: handoff_pending is COMPUTED, not a DB status; if bot→miniapp interval >7d → bot_completed_stale, raw phone purged after 30d (2026-06-20 rule). MINI APP part: miniapp_opened (HMAC initData valid, session_id match) → consent_biometry → doc_upload (passport) → selfie_upload → moderation_pending → needs_changes → verification_rejected → profile_basic…profile_preview (mini:8-14) → quiz (mini:15-17, anketa published) → (→ active) after quiz (mini:18+).

verification_status (§1.4): not_started → phone_verified → documents_uploaded → liveness_uploaded → pending_review → needs_changes(M) → approved(M) / rejected(M); revoked(M) = Stage 2. Rest MVP.

profile_completion (§1.5): not_started·in_progress·completed (pending_remoderation=Stage 2). quiz_completion: not_started·in_progress·completed. All MVP.

Anketa moderation status (§1.6): draft→under_review→needs_changes→approved(not visible)→published(user publishes, in matching)→rejected; hidden=Stage 2. photo_status (§1.7): uploaded·under_review·approved·needs_replacement·rejected (MVP); hidden_by_user=Stage 2. doc_status (§1.8): pending_review·needs_changes·approved·rejected (MVP). complaint (§1.9): new·in_progress·confirmed·not_confirmed·action_taken·closed (MVP); requires_clarification·escalated=Stage 2. restriction (§1.10): none·warning·temp_block·perm_block (MVP); interest_limited·chat_limited·hidden_from_recommendations·re_verification=Stage 2. Other (§1.11): user↔user block active·removed; match_request pending·accepted·declined·withdrawn·expired(72h); chat active·read_only (archived=Stage2); tariff free/standard/pro/vip/individual + subscription/payment states MVP-base; boost/gift MVP-when-legal/dev-ready.

KEY TRANSITIONS: onboarding→active gated on quiz completion (spec); verification runs bot→miniapp linear; approved gates ability-to-publish but publish is a separate user action.

founder_amendments.area: Matching model (feed → Match of the Day)
founder_amendments.change: Fundamental pivot 2026-06-25: NOT a feed/scrollable list of profiles. Instead ONE algorithm-selected match at a time + editorial 'match story' (reasons it fits / cautions / advice) + progressive de-anonymization. Pre-mutual visible: first name, values/worldview, general work sphere, personal traits; HIDDEN: surname, age, photo, specific employer/title. After mutual interest → reveal → chat. Tone: recommendation, not imposition. Anti-Tinder: user receives an offer and decides yes/no rather than choosing among many. Overrides the original feed/grid/magazine-spread options.

Plus/Pro replaced by Free / Standard (250k UZS, 1mo) / Pro (1.2M, 6mo) / VIP (2M, 6mo TBC) / Individual. Free = tech/marketing status. VIP explicitly does NOT buy access to people. Individual positioned as 'personal support', visually separate from VIP, no guaranteed-marriage promises. International test prices ($19.99/$89.99/$149.99) = Stage 2 (RU-3).
MVP uses local providers Payme / Click / Uzcard / Humo; international Visa/MC = Stage 2. Do NOT launch tariffs without terms/refunds/logs in place.
Multilingual UI in MVP: UZ/RU + EN/TR (Turkey test); KK later. Chat auto-translation = after MVP.

verified_name (checked legal name, stored separately, never shown to others) ≠ display_name/nickname (shown to others, goes through moderation). User is shown as verified but picks their own displayed name. Subscription status visible to user+admin; public tariff display to others is a separate UX decision (no social pressure).

Added managed dictionaries shown as 'text + soft icon', anti-stigma, no red flags: marital_status, children, religiosity, employment, family_model, education, readiness_to_marry, worldview. Older-audience friendly.
Sensitive questions (health/drugs): values hidden; visibility levels hidden / after_mutual / by_consent / matching_safety_only; require separate consent (legal). Added to MVP anketa.
Geo of birth + residence (RUz reference: область→район→город) plus partner geo-preferences (≤3). Photos: 3 photos in MVP (portrait + height mandatory, family photo optional per OD-8).

Increased visibility (worded as 'повышенная видимость', NOT 'top of the day', no aggressive gamification) and digital gifts (as a sign of respect, not 'buy attention') — in MVP only if legal/dev ready; otherwise deferred. Physical gifts / international expansion = after MVP.

Governing meta-rule: every idea is categorized MVP / after-MVP / legal review / technical review / marketing test / owner decision — do not bloat the MVP. Founder consistently cuts complexity when a simpler path exists (esp. via Telegram-native mechanisms: contact share, Mini App initData, TG signals). Previously-closed OD questions MAY be reopened when a simpler path is found. This is the whitelist rationale: TG-native simplifications that deviate from raw chats are intentional.

Contractor KUCH ($10k), domain baxtlilar.uz. Hard bans (intentional, treat violations as bugs): no purple dating gradients/neon/acid colors; no flame/spark hearts, swipe aesthetic, Tinder references; no artificial urgency ('hurry'/'limited spots'/timers); no wedding kitsch (rings/doves/veil as main image); no showing passports/documents/selfies in marketing; no anxious red alert icons in UI; no result promises ('find love in 5 min'/'guarantee marriage'/'100% safety'); no fictional stats/'successful couples' without written consent; no sexualized/objectifying imagery; no 'approved by Muftiyat' without official confirmation.
